title: Lifting semisimple characters of $p$-adic types from fixed-point subgroups
summary: Given a $p$-adic group $G=\mathbf{G}(F)$ and a finite group $Γ\subset\mathrm{Aut}_F(\mathbf{G})$ such that the fixed-point subgroup $\mathbf{G}^Γ$ is reductive, we show that every semisimple character (in the sense of Bushnell and Kutzko) of a type for $G^Γ= \mathbf{G}^Γ(F)$ arises as the restriction of a semisimple character of a type for $G$. We achieve this by explicitly lifting the truncated Kim--Yu datum (or character-datum) that parametrizes the semisimple character for $G^Γ$ to a character-datum that parametrizes a semisimple character for $G$.
